name: prajzo-platform
description: Prajzo: web development studio and website customization platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @prajzo/api" "npm run dev -w @prajzo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prajzo/web && npm run build -w @prajzo/api
scripts.host:local: npm run build && npm run host:local -w @prajzo/api -- --restart
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
